exposure: factors in the previous traumatic birth
coping behaviour during the subsequent pregnancy
choosing a home birth in a high-risk pregnancy
cohort: 474 Dutch women (mean age 28.9 years) who had experienced a previous traumatic childbirth and a subsequent birth.
finding: Making a birth plan, choosing a home birth in a high-risk pregnancy, and having a planned caesarean section were statistically significant correlates of a positive subsequent birth experience.
mod_finding: Choosing a home birth in a high-risk pregnancy and having a planned caesarean section were significantly correlated with a positive subsequent birth experience.
cross-section timing: Data was collected via an online survey after women had experienced both their previous traumatic birth and their subsequent birth.
